entry.title: Nvidia Mulls $10 Billion Anthropic IPO Backing, Reuters Says
entry.summary: Nvidia Corp. is considering investing as much as $10 billion in Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering, which could become the biggest IPO of all time, Reuters reported.

entry.title: Fidji Simo Joins Data Center Startup Nscale’s Board Ahead of IPO
entry.summary: Nscale Global Holdings appointed former OpenAI and Meta Platforms Inc. executive Fidji Simo to its board as the data center startup bolsters its ranks of directors ahead of an initial public offering.

entry.title: Tencent-Backed Chipmaker Enflame to Debut After $911 Million IPO
entry.summary: Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., is set to begin trading in Shanghai Friday after raising about 6.12 billion yuan ($911m), as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers enters the public market.

entry.title: Anthropic Investor Leads Funding for Off-Grid AI Power Startup
entry.summary: A startup that builds off-grid power systems for data centers said it raised $120 million in a Series A funding round led by Spark Capital, an investor in artificial-intelligence developer Anthropic PBC.

entry.title: Meta Upgraded at JPMorgan as Muse Highlights Better AI Position
entry.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. was upgraded to overweight at JPMorgan Chase & Co. on Thursday, the latest example of how sentiment toward the Facebook parent’s position with artificial intelligence has been improving.

entry.title: ‘AI Economy’ Driving Earnings Strength, Says JPM’s Caffrey
entry.summary: Jack Caffrey, equity portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, says spending related to “the enthusiasm around artificial intelligence” is broadening out earnings themes. Caffrey warns of “a hiccup or two over the next few months” as companies need to borrow more to support their growth. He speaks on “Bloomberg Brief.” (Source: Bloomberg)
